_about: How the war is won (RULES.md §11) [balanced]. Checked at the end of every turn (sudden victory) and after the last turn (the Armistice Score). See docs/DATA.md.

sudden.reason: France's will to fight has collapsed.

armistice._about: Score = GER Will − the average of FRA and GBR Will + VP of Entente named boxes Germany owns − VP of German named boxes the Entente owns. Above +margin: German victory; below −margin: Entente victory; otherwise a stalemate peace.
